patches.reason: DTO-only facade preserves public identity/settings but delegates native management/execution to the pure application-access getter. Concrete closed assembly uses the original driver, installer, model manifest/catalog, continuation port, original usage reader and same ProviderRuntimeHost. The identical runtimeHost is also supplied to makePmProviderHostServices and makePmProviderContinuationRequests so retained instances recheck current generation authority rather than capturing first-acquisition context.execution. Native continuation offers originate in the shared ACP adapter, which owns capture of the original runtime binding identity. Optional raw logs explicitly disabled.

Narrow AntigravityProfileDirectories Reference preserves existing app-owned profile/history/temp paths, and original installer uses existing per-instance stateDirectory. No credential files are inspected, imported, relocated or converted. Bound HostProcess environment/Home/cwd are respected; installation paths expand against bound home/cwd. Auth publishes the actual private credential binding and configured source method. A per-profile cached source sweep is awaited once, so creating a second cwd-specific driver cannot delete another live runtime temp directory.

Original ACP flavor supplies metadata-only UUID4/native .meta cwd + .db ownership verification. No prompt, generic new-session probe, SQLite usage completion inference or credential access. Shared ACP owns negotiated operation-scoped evidence and native resume acknowledgement/stable-state checks; explicit unsupported turn/message cursors are not fabricated.

Prompt attachment lookup now requires the supplied ProviderHost resolver rather than source-app attachmentStore. The production PM Host remains authoritative for registered files. Remove obsolete selfInvocation dependency; shared ACP RuntimeHost stdio transport, permission admission, native cancellation and lifecycle remain owned by T13. No source business MCP/browser/device service is enabled.

canLogout is projected only from the actual authenticated native handshake, never from the lightweight synthetic installation probe. Installation/catalog/authenticated identity/native inference remain separate; no platform or account readiness is fabricated.

Retain original native behavior suites while replacing reference-only t3 config/settings/secret/business host layers with the shared actual-PM native-test-host.testkit.ts composition, bound native platform and real RuntimeHost. Source adapter PDF fixtures register their actual bytes through the PM attachment registry; declared size matches those bytes. Pure prompt tests use an explicit test-owned attachment lookup port. Remove only the obsolete t3-code.html_render business artifact fixture, which requires a tool/server not admitted in PM.

Repair the controlled native executable, not the source parser: pinned effect-acp schema-v1.gen.ts, client.ts legacy negotiation and antigravity-initialize.json establish that native Antigravity reports protocolVersion 2 with v1 agentInfo/agentCapabilities, authenticate/logout and terminal stopReason replies. Decode requests and encode replies/notifications with that original v1 schema; grouped model options use group, not groupId. Remove invented incomplete usage counters. Replace the text .db placeholder with executable-owned SQLite identity/cwd/model/mode/calculator/turn/state persistence. Direct and legacy resumes read existing identity/cwd/idle state without rewriting metadata, creating replacement sessions or probe prompts; calculator totals demonstrate actual persisted continuation. Retain custom native HOME/environment isolation, model enforcement, failed credentials, native failure/cancel, callback exceptions and temporary setup cleanup. Add real process-crash unfinished-work rejection, persisted identity tampering rejection, loopback path/destination/state rejection, native denial and separate controlled account-flow binding. No production family, shared ACP or host change was needed; no Antigravity CLI, Google account, real model or platform acceptance is claimed.

parentIntegration: Production driver/capability/installation/protocol maps register the closed family exports. Shared registration/build/manifests/locks remain parent-owned.
Retain original driver/layer/controller per full context identity until invalidation/shutdown (SolHostLifetime); account and maintenance leases still use existing PM locks/revisions.

Only provisional instances use a private source scope. Parent management owns lease admission, peer revision invalidation and release; installer cancellation is registered atomically with start and drained before lease release.

Shared ACP T13 supplies readAcpSessionEvidence(runtime), actual negotiated protocol accessor, pre-resume source metadata capture, zero-prompt legacy resume and RuntimeHost stdio admission/cleanup; never static protocol/version guesses.
T16 consumes original AntigravityUsage.layer and reader; no usage product/persistence rewrite in this slice.

platformAndAccountPrerequisites.publishedPinnedRuntime: Source pins Antigravity 1.3.0 executable/harness pairs for darwin/linux/win32 on x64/arm64; unsupported host combinations fail explicitly. Linux is not macOS and installation metadata does not prove auth/readiness. No platform-specific capability is emulated.
platformAndAccountPrerequisites.linux: Actual Google runtime requires IPv6 socket support, functional Google networking and a usable CA bundle; original WSL IPv6 diagnostic remains. One-file runtime may unpack about 1 GiB; installer performs original disk/hash/member/native-handshake verification.
platformAndAccountPrerequisites.windows: Original native Windows executable/process cleanup and shallow temp path handling remain. POSIX shell fixture tests are explicitly skipped on Windows; Windows native acceptance requires Windows hardware/runtime, not a false Linux pass.
platformAndAccountPrerequisites.authentication: oauth-personal needs an eligible Google Antigravity subscription/account; oauth-business needs GCP project/location and enterprise access; gemini-api-key needs a configured actual key; agent-platform needs actual API key or GCP project/location/native authorized ADC per original source. No login, inference or account prerequisite was exercised here.
platformAndAccountPrerequisites.callback: Browser login must originate from the native Google URL with one nonempty state and a native 127.0.0.1 high-port redirect. Forward only the validated same loopback destination/state; no global credential import or remote callback destination.
